correctness.rationale: The support-map formula reduces each bulk coordinate to exactly five interval-winner indicators. Direct exhaustive rational sums over all possible orderings of five through nine labels establish the complete local covariance and squared-radius moment table; the included verifier replays these finite lemmas. Endpoint contributions give the exact inertia. Four-dependence, a positive computed long-run variance, and a rigorous Lindeberg blocking argument establish the infinite-family radial normal limit; random simulations are not used as a proof.

value.rationale: Computes the exact mean squared radial separation in all dimensions n>=5, the complete finite-range interior covariance, and a nondegenerate normal fluctuation law with explicitly evaluated rational variance. The target is motivated by Gaussian normal-cone exposure and provides geometric information independent of existing f-vector formulas. The sign change of coordinate correlations at distances three and four is a structural, not merely nominal, feature of the first path-polytope refinement.
